name: io.github.iowarp/paraview-mcp
title: CLIO Paraview
description: See and measure 3D scientific data in ParaView, on this machine or over SSH, in a live view.

tools.name: open_view
tools.description:
Open a dataset or restore a saved scene, and show it in a live ParaView view.

With neither path nor scene, it shows the ParaView session already running
where ParaView is, or the current scene.

tools.name: create_filter
tools.description: Add one filter to the scene's pipeline. It commits whole or not at all.

tools.name: remove_scene_object
tools.description: Remove an object and everything built on it from the pipeline.

tools.name: set_representation
tools.description: Change an object's representation, colouring, opacity or visibility.

tools.name: set_timestep
tools.description: Show another time step, or follow the latest one.

tools.name: set_camera
tools.description: Place the camera, or turn and zoom it from where it is.

tools.name: fit_camera
tools.description: Point the camera so everything, or one object, fills the view.

tools.name: inspect_selection
tools.description: Exact field values at the point the person picked in the view.

tools.name: measure_field
tools.description: Exact statistics and a histogram of a field at the current time step.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: A PNG rendered by ParaView at the camera the view last reported.

tools.name: export_artifact
tools.description: Write a figure of the current view as a PNG file.

tools.name: export_scene
tools.description: Write the scene manifest, and a ParaView state file beside it.

tools.name: scene_state
tools.description: Where ParaView is attached, the dataset, the pipeline, time and view.

resources.name: paraview_view
resources.description: The live ParaView view: trame, framed through the host's service route.
